Callout.Name: Surveillance - Suspected Robbery Crew
Callout.Message: Request for surveillance of a crew believed to be planning a robbery.
Callout.Advisory: Two vehicles, three suspects, no weapons seen.

Script.Line: We have been parked here an hour and nobody has said anything about it.
I am waiting for a mate. That is all this is.
You want to search the car? Go ahead. It is not my car.

Stages.Stage: One of them is out and walking the block.
They are moving. Both vehicles, northbound.
Vehicle recovered. Two in custody, one on the floor.

Lines.Briefing: Watch them. If they move on a target, that is when we go, and we go as one.
Lines.Approach: They have been sat on that corner an hour. Keep out of sight and keep the log.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
